description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the schedule to the order establishing the Universtity of Colombo Sri Lanka published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1948/58 of 08.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette contains an order made under Section 27(1) of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the schedule of the University of Colombo. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of subsidiary legislation under an existing Act, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a minister is named, the primary content is legal/regulatory in nature, not about government personnel or structure.
